name: PROJECTILE MOTION – ALL IMPORTANT FORMULAS
description:
🚀 

Given:

u = Initial Velocity
θ = Angle of Projection
g = Acceleration due to Gravity

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. HORIZONTAL COMPONENT OF VELOCITY

ux = u cosθ

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

2. VERTICAL COMPONENT OF VELOCITY

uy = u sinθ

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

3. VELOCITY AT ANY TIME t

Horizontal Velocity

vx = u cosθ

Vertical Velocity

vy = u sinθ − gt

Resultant Velocity

v = √[(u cosθ)² + (u sinθ − gt)²]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

4. EQUATION OF TRAJECTORY

y = x tanθ − (g x²)/(2u² cos²θ)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

5. TIME OF FLIGHT (T)

T = (2u sinθ)/g

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

6. MAXIMUM HEIGHT (H)

H = (u² sin²θ)/(2g)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

7. HORIZONTAL RANGE (R)

R = (u² sin2θ)/g

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

8. RANGE ON HORIZONTAL PLANE

Rmax = u²/g

When θ = 45°

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

9. TIME TO REACH MAXIMUM HEIGHT

t = (u sinθ)/g

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

10. VELOCITY AT MAXIMUM HEIGHT

v = u cosθ

Vertical Velocity = 0

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

11. MAXIMUM HEIGHT USING TIME

H = ½gt²

(where t = time to reach highest point)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

12. RELATION BETWEEN HEIGHT & RANGE

H = R tanθ /4

(For θ = 45°)

H = R/4

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

13. RANGE FOR COMPLEMENTARY ANGLES

R(θ) = R(90° − θ)

Example:

30° and 60°
20° and 70°

have same range.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

14. SPECIAL VALUES

θ = 45°

Range = Maximum

θ = 90°

Range = 0

θ = 0°

Range = 0

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

15. IMPORTANT RATIOS

Time Upward : Time Downward

= 1 : 1

Velocity at same height

= Same magnitude

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

16. KINEMATIC EQUATIONS FOR VERTICAL MOTION

v = u + at

v² = u² + 2as

s = ut + ½at²

For Projectile:

a = −g

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

17. MOST IMPORTANT EXAM FORMULAS

Time of Flight

T = 2u sinθ/g

Maximum Height

H = u²sin²θ/2g

Range

R = u²sin2θ/g

Trajectory

y = x tanθ − gx²/(2u²cos²θ)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TRICK TO REMEMBER

T → 2sinθ

H → sin²θ

R → sin2θ

"T-H-R"

Time → 2sinθ
Height → sin²θ
Range → sin2θ
